Review Peridot?

Peridot, developed by Niantic, has received overwhelmingly positive feedback for its innovative use of augmented reality and AI to create unique virtual pets called Dots. Users appreciate the game's immersive experience, likening it to a modernized Tamagotchi. The Peridot AR Tamagotchi team is praised for encouraging real-world movement and community engagement. Makers with extensive AR experience commend the technical brilliance and design, highlighting the Perigenetics System's ability to generate infinite unique pets. Some users note minor AR glitches but remain impressed by the overall experience.
